description: Show the authenticated user the tickets currently delivered to their XP marketplace account, all backed by XP's Quality XPerience Guarantee. Use when the user says 'my tickets', 'what tickets do I have', 'pull up my seats for tonight', or asks about an upcoming event they've already bought. Surfaces only delivered tickets — pending swaps and seller-side listings appear in `list_my_listings`. Requires auth. Do not use to list past orders or browse the marketplace; this is strictly delivered tickets on the user's account.

limit.description: How many tickets to return, 1-200. Defaults to 25.

offset.description: Skip this many. Use with limit to page.

name: get_my_tickets
title: Get My Tickets
